mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS shows sustained 3-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last 3 months signals a supply-side contraction, which reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last 2 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% over the last quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3% in the last month, it signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows < 1% in 3 months and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances when both conditions are met.
